findings.summary: The runbook restarts an uninstalled gateway unit on first install and reloads host Caddy although the approved service is containerized.

findings.summary: Gateway request logging exposes OAuth code/state query values in its purported status field.
findings.evidence: Probe A: exit 0; callback query code=SYNTHETIC_CODE&state=SYNTHETIC_STATE appears in captured logging. remote/gateway/server.py:38 assigns the request line args[0] to status. Independent Anthropic finding 1 confirms the source defect; primary severity remains medium because no usable session credential or account takeover was demonstrated.

findings.summary: The mutation marker accepts arbitrary nonempty values, and GET logout clears the cookie without guards or revoking its server session.
findings.evidence: Probe A: exit 0; X-Flow-Request: wrong passes the real HTTP guard (200 with an isolated successful runtime), foreign-Origin GET logout returns 302/clearing cookie, and the token still resolves afterward. server.py:189 checks nonempty marker rather than value 1; logout has no server-side revocation. No Origin bypass for command POST was demonstrated.

findings.summary: Telegram alerts still omit a working review URL and safe inline actions, and retry callbacks remain unsupported.
findings.evidence: Probe B: exit 0; submit_telegram_command rejects retry with INVALID_COMMAND. Source recheck: app.py:107 permits pause/resume only; telegram_bot.py /estado supplies only those callbacks; notifications.py TelegramSender sends chat_id/text without reply_markup, review URL, task or classified cause. Telegram bot/send suites pass within the 45 gateway tests; they do not establish the missing alert actions.

findings.summary: The public note command is still advertised and validated without a laptop dispatcher.

Existing retry reason/RUN.notes reuse remains valid, as PLAN.md specifies; it does not execute the advertised standalone command.

findings.summary: The phone brief form still cannot edit acceptance criteria.
findings.evidence: Source recheck: page.tsx:372-380 always submits field=objective and a string value; renderTask has only a brief textarea. Laptop bt_remote_edit supports acceptance_criteria lists. The current recovering-only form gate and failed reopen are F26; dropped edit fields are F33.

findings.summary: Run-level Reabrir ejecución supplies no task identity to a task-scoped operation.
findings.evidence: Source recheck: run-level commandForm(reopen, kind:run) has no taskId. bt_remote_commands.TASK_SCOPED, _member_state and dispatch_run_command require params.task; such a run-level command cannot satisfy the member precondition. Task-specific recovery is independently recorded as F26.

findings.summary: Ordinary plans waiting for approval previously emitted no plan.waiting event without a scheduler decision.

findings.summary: Gateway restart still loses the last snapshot; the replacement replay hub is not integrated into production.
findings.evidence: Probe B: exit 0; a runtime with an offline cached snapshot serves it, but a newly constructed runtime using the same database returns None. app.py keeps snapshot_cache only in memory. stream.py now has a bounded StreamHub and resync support, but main.py/app.py/server.py never instantiate or serve it (F21); do not carry forward claims about the removed SnapshotEventStream as current production evidence.

findings.summary: Delivered/dropped Telegram history and abandoned expired sessions remain unbounded.
findings.evidence: Probe B: exit 0; creating a new session leaves an expired abandoned row. Source recheck: notifications.py has no 90-day deletion of telegram_outbox/delivery_history; SessionStore expires sessions only on presentation. Laptop Ledger.rows loads the complete history before endpoint slicing. Withdraw the old unbounded production SSE deque claim: it was removed, replacement StreamHub has maxlen=1000 and is unused. Its unbounded subscriber queues are not a demonstrated production exposure.

findings.summary: No stable offline-start timestamp reaches the phone.
findings.evidence: Probe B: exit 0; cached snapshot retains generatedAt while laptop exposes only online=False, with no offlineSince/cachedAt. app.py:211-228 serializes only online; page.tsx:424 says LAPTOP SIN CONEXIÓN without sin conexión desde HH:MM. LivenessMonitor has a monotonic offline_since internally but never translates it into a public wall-clock timestamp.

Isolated laptop remote suite: exit 0, 54 tests, including real review response redaction. Snapshot, events and reviews retain the shared recursive redactor; no exhaustive secret-detection claim.

findings.summary: The local panel previously had no inherited systemd listener implementation.
findings.evidence: Combined isolated unittest discovery in skill/scripts for test_platform.py and test_page*.py: exit 0, 68 tests in 13.412 s, including inherited-listener reload and activation-environment regressions. No live systemd restart was performed.

findings.summary: The phone still discards unknown-outcome command envelopes and creates a fresh idempotency key on resubmission.

Independent Anthropic finding 5 confirmed after inspecting the full sendCommand implementation.

findings.summary: Public command schema disagrees with production commands, fields and key limits.
findings.evidence: Source recheck plus Probe B: schema lacks answer-decision, uses string route and singular answer, and models edit-brief as brief; phone uses route object, answers and field/value. Schema max key length is 128; laptop validate rejects 121 characters (limit 120). JSON syntax checks exit 0 and are not semantic schema validation. Event target normalization remains repaired.

findings.summary: Production gateway serves neither SSE route; the replacement tested StreamHub is disconnected from runtime and HTTP.
findings.evidence: Probe A: exit 0; authenticated GET /api/remote/v1/events/stream?after=abc AND /api/remote/v1/events both return 404. main.py creates GatewayRuntime; app.py never imports/instantiates StreamHub; server.py has no stream handler. Phone page.tsx:260 still opens the first route, so the feed remains empty; its new five-second snapshot polling does not supply feed events. Laptop feed also filters ordinary flow transitions. Keep the working poll fallback; wire a real stream and explicit cursor/replay adapter.

findings.summary: Rejected-task reopen passes its new precondition alias but fails in the real scheduler; recovery forms still cannot be used end to end.

Exact phone reopen envelope now passes _matches_precondition, but real dispatch_handlers -> ops.apply -> Scheduler.reopen returns FAILED/EFFECT_FAILED: NOT_ALLOWED: only a blocked task of a live run can be reopened (T1 is recovering). findings.summary: Command rate limits remain shared by owner login across sessions rather than per session as R17 specifies.
findings.evidence: Source recheck: server.py:141 keys commands/challenges on authenticated login (dav033), shared across sessions, rather than token/session identity. This is a stricter aggregate cap, not an authorization bypass. No owner-approved R17 amendment is evidenced.

findings.summary: Concurrent distinct-key stale preconditions are now serialized with the ledger effect.
findings.evidence: Probe D: exit 0; two simultaneously submitted running-precondition commands execute exactly one handler (entry state running); results are OK and REJECTED/STALE_PRECONDITION, with two audit rows. _EFFECT_LOCK now encloses state read/check, challenge/reservation, handler and outcome write. Isolated laptop remote suite: exit 0, 54 tests including test_concurrent_commands_recheck_state_under_the_effect_lock. This verifies process-local ledger command concurrency, not every possible external scheduler race.

findings.summary: Production snapshots omit the timestamp fields the phone uses for last signal of life and discard plan detail/revision metadata.
findings.evidence: Probe C: exit 0; production run has lastActivityAt but lastSeenAt/updatedAt are None; phone only consumes the latter fields and attempt.updatedAt, while production emits last_activity_at. Source recheck: bt_remote_api._snapshot still emits plan tasks=[] without revision/criteria and omits run/task revision. Browser fixtures supply the missing metadata.

findings.summary: Stalled-attempt notifications start after 15 minutes although the specification requires more than 10 minutes.
findings.evidence: Probe B: exit 0; a live attempt emits no attempt.stalled at +660 s and does at +901 s. bt_remote_events.py:10 still uses 15*60, against SPEC R10 >10 min. Independent Anthropic review of this full source was not completed; this is the primary auditor's own source/runtime finding.

findings.summary: The previously exposed post-expiry SSE continuation is no longer reachable because production streaming was removed.
findings.evidence: Probe A: exit 0; both authenticated candidate SSE endpoints return 404. Full server.py contains no stream/wait/write loop, so the old post-expiry delivery reproduction no longer applies. This closes that exposure only; it does not approve removing streaming. Lost required functionality is open F21, and session-expiry enforcement must be rechecked when a stream is restored.

findings.summary: Every phone pinned retry still fails: the new gateway selector adapter does not recognize route_id.

Real GatewayRuntime -> LaptopClient -> keyed HTTP route_post returns REJECTED/INVALID_COMMAND (params.route must be nonempty text), stored=False, before state/effects. The new gateway test uses route.id and therefore passes without testing the phone dialect. model/account copying is preserved; do not drop the selected route.

findings.summary: Gateway public-envelope adapter drops the round number and edited brief/criteria fields, breaking both phone operations.
findings.evidence: Probe F: exit 0; a real open round has target_state={state:open}, but translating the exact phone command drops round and real laptop HTTP returns STALE_PRECONDITION with the round unchanged. A valid server challenge plus current real run state and phone edit-brief task/field/value yields params={task:T1} and FAILED/EFFECT_FAILED: edit-brief requiere un brief de tarea no vacío. app.py:36-42 omits round/field/value; target.taskId preserves task. These fail independently of F26 and the current precondition can be valid. Anthropic finding 2 independently confirms both omissions.
